newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austrian shares end off, gains seen after expiry.
newsitem.headline: Austrian shares end off, gains seen after expiry.

text.p: Austrian shares ended lower on Wednesday after a quiet session but for demand in individual shares and traders predicted some pick-up after expiry of June futures and options on Friday.
The blue-chip ATX index ended down 0.45 percent or 5.92 points at 1,297.47 points. Among its constituents 13 shares fell, seven rose and one was unchanged.
Volumes were heavy among national grid company Verbund and Vienna airport operator Flughafen and demand was also strong in insurer EA Generali.
"The rest was just dabbling," said one trader.
Dealers cited poor liquidity as the main problem currently, rather than pressure from the German Bund future or U.S. treasuries.
"We are going down mainly because of a lack of buying interest," said one.
The session's top decliner was Leykam, shedding 1.56 percent to close at 310 schillings.
Brewer Brau Union led the gainers, climbing 2.57 percent to 759 schillings.
The June ATX future slipped 12 points to 1,292.
